SOM.note: Business-to-government payment services are only being developed, and no e-procurement is mentioned.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Somalia Governor says SIPS, launched in January 2025 and operated by the Somalia Payment Switch set up as a partnership between the Central Bank and 13 commercial banks, enables instant interoperable payments across participating institutions.

SOM.note: No consumer rules or complaints body mentioned.
A PAPSS link is only being worked on for end of 2026, and no corridor is in service.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Somalia Governor says SIPS supports government disbursements to citizens.
The Central Bank of Somalia Governor says SIPS, launched January 2025, supports person-to-person transfers and merchant payments, and that mobile money operators serve most Somalis in daily life.

SOM.note: Mobile money operators are not yet connected to SIPS, so no wallet-to-bank link is stated.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Somalia Governor says SIPS supports payments to government.
